subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Modern convenience often asks for information.”?
options: People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.
Recycling works better when people know exactly where to put things and why it matters.
People should know what they are giving when they choose it.
When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Recycling works better when people know exactly where to put things and why it matters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Modern convenience often asks for information. People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Modern convenience often asks for information. People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」，答案為「People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
